name: Pi Web Showcase
description: A polished local marketplace covering every plugin state and capability type.

plugins.name: lineup-card
plugins.description: Skill-only plugin that turns a rough roster into a polished match-day lineup.

examplePrompts: 用首发阵容卡帮我排一套 4-3-3，并说明每个位置的理由

plugins.name: weather-station
plugins.description: Skill + MCP plugin with a live forecast tool. Installed version is one minor behind, so the card shows an update.

examplePrompts: 查一下上海未来三小时的降雨风险

plugins.name: kanban-board
plugins.description: MCP + UI plugin: an interactive kanban board rendered inline and in the right workspace panel.

examplePrompts: 打开看板，把支付回调任务移到进行中

plugins.name: metrics-studio
plugins.description: MCP + UI plugin: a polished metrics dashboard with KPI tiles and a CSS bar chart.

examplePrompts: 打开指标工作台，看看本周的构建成功率

plugins.name: terminal-lab
plugins.description: MCP-only plugin used to show the disabled state: no skills, no UI, one probe tool.

plugins.name: pdf-notes
plugins.description: Skill plugin that also declares commands/hooks/agents, which pi-web reports as unsupported diagnostics.

plugins.name: broken-bridge
plugins.description: MCP plugin whose server file is missing: install succeeds, the server reports an error.
